topNews.text: Rescued Orangutans Released Into Isolated Forest Are Now Raising Babies, Creating New Wild Population
topNews.excerpt: Fifteen years ago, conservationists began releasing rescued orangutans into a protected forest in Sumatra where no others from their species were living.
